Select assay ChEMBL ID from assays, target_type and tax_id from target_dictionary, canonical_smiles from compound_structures, molecule ChEMBL ID from molecule_dictionary, standard_type and pchembl_value from activities.
Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno.
Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1801', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value is not null.
Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row.
Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
Limit 1000 rows.
